payload.title: Garden Wedding Ideas and What to Plan For
payload.excerpt: A garden wedding is a ceremony, a reception or both held outdoors among planted grounds, lawns or orchards. It works when the styling and the backup plan are decided together, because the garden that sets the mood also needs a plan for the weather.
key_takeaways: The eight real garden weddings below come from our own published stories, each linked to the full account.
Let an existing path set the line of the aisle, keep aisle markers low, and design the lighting for the hour your reception ends, not the hour it begins.
Before you book, confirm that the covered space holds every guest seated for both the ceremony and dinner, who makes the call to move under cover and by what time on the day.
A garden wedding abroad adds questions about the garden's months, guest travel and who looks after the day on the venue's side.

faq.a: A ceremony, a reception or both held outdoors among planted grounds, lawns or orchards. It works when the styling and the wet weather plan are decided together.

faq.q: Can I have a wedding in my own garden?
faq.a: Yes, and the same questions apply: covered space for every guest, power outdoors, a route without steps and lighting after dark.

faq.q: What is a garden party theme for a wedding?
faq.a: A daylight theme built around an afternoon ceremony, a long lunch outdoors, lawn games and relaxed styling.

faq.q: What is the dress code for a garden party wedding?
faq.a: Whatever the invitation sets, ideally with a note on what the ground is like underfoot. For outfit ideas, see [what guests wear to a garden wedding](/what-to-wear-to-a-garden-wedding).

faq.q: What happens if it rains at a garden wedding?
faq.a: The wedding moves to the covered space agreed with the venue. Before you book, confirm where it is, that it holds every guest seated, and who makes the call and by what time.
